summary: Even the base case underperforms the S&P; the stock is exposed to multiple compression and a 2027 refinancing.

findings.claim: A de-rating toward the peer median alone would cut the price by roughly a third even if guidance is met.

evidence.quote: we expect revenue growth of 8% to 10% and operating margin of 16% to 17%

findings.claim: Senior notes mature in fiscal 2027 and may be refinanced on worse terms.

evidence.quote: consisting of $400 million of 4.25% senior notes due fiscal 2027
